report:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: drlinq-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]
    volumes:
      - drlinq_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks: [drlinq-internal]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d ${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 20s

  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:2.35.7
    container_name: drlinq-n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      DB_TYPE: postgresdb
      DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST: postgres
      DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT: 5432
      DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE: ${N8N_DB}
      DB_POSTGRESDB_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]
      N8N_HOST: n8n.drlinq.ir
      N8N_PORT: 5678
      N8N_PROTOCOL: https
      WEBHOOK_URL: https://n8n.drlinq.ir/
      N8N_PROXY_HOPS: 1
      N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: [REDACTED]
      GENERIC_TIMEZONE: Asia/Tehran
      TZ: Asia/Tehran
      N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED: 'false'
      N8N_PERSONALIZATION_ENABLED: 'false'
    volumes:
      - drlinq_n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
    networks: [drlinq-internal]

  caddy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    container_name: drlinq-caddy
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on: [n8n]
    ports:
      - '80:80'
      - '443:443'
    volumes:
      - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - drlinq_caddy_data:/data
      - drlinq_caddy_config:/config
    networks: [drlinq-internal]

volumes:
  drlinq_postgres_data:
    name: drlinq_postgres_data
  drlinq_n8n_data:
    name: drlinq_n8n_data
  drlinq_caddy_data:
    name: drlinq_caddy_data
  drlinq_caddy_config:
    name: drlinq_caddy_config

networks:
  drlinq-internal:
    name: drlinq-internal
    driver: bridge
